required_boundaries.runtime_boundary: Batch 03 may define runtime owner closure criteria but may not start, own, host, or monopolize runtime.
required_boundaries.data_boundary: Batch 03 may define evidence expectations but may not own Truth Spine claims, Oracle rulings, identity data, audit records, or persistent owner state.
required_boundaries.governance_boundary: Batch 03 remains governed by IGLS-1 and the Governance Layer; it creates no constitutional authority.
required_boundaries.security_boundary: Identity & Access and Security/Privacy remain canonical authorities for roles, permissions, and sensitive exposure.
required_boundaries.contract_boundary: Batch 03 defines conceptual contracts only; no APIs, schemas, or runtime implementation details.
required_boundaries.evidence_boundary: Evidence envelopes may be defined conceptually, but evidence verification remains with existing authorities.
